a.lede: The company said it will still accept songs that were made with AI assistance, but not fully generated.
a.title: Tidal to ban and remove millions of AI-generated tracks as AI slop inundates music streaming

b.title: Tidal bans 100% AI-generated music with plans to delete more than 27m tracks
